subject: Magic
text: Characters have 3 spell slots per level out of 4 available spells, and magic learned is permanent.

evidence.quote: You have 3 slots but 4 spells...once spell from each level will have to be negated. So choose wisely...otherwise you'll find yourself in a major slump since the magic you learn is permanent!

subject: Corneria Inn
text: The inn in Corneria is the cheapest place to rest and save.

evidence.quote: always save at the inn in Corneria. It's the cheapest for the same return.

subject: Knight
text: Upon becoming a Knight, the Fighter can use level 1 to 3 White Magic.

evidence.quote: Once he becomes a Knight he can use low level white magic(1-3), which becomes incredibly useful outside of battles.

subject: Ninja
text: Upon becoming a Ninja, the Thief gains increased attack power and can use low level Black Magic.

evidence.quote: once he becomes a Ninja, his attack power is increased significantly and he can begin to use low level black magic.

subject: Corneria Castle
text: Train outside around Corneria Castle to reach level 3 before proceeding to the upcoming battle.

evidence.quote: Stay outside around Corneria castle and start to gain your levels to 3, any higher you'll easily win the upcoming battle ahead.

subject: Garland
text: Garland has 106 HP, and the party can defeat him by having the White Mage heal, the Black Mage cast Fire, and the Red Mage cast Fire while others attack.

evidence.quote: Boss Battle: Garland       HP: 106...Have the white mage heal, the black mage user fire, the red mage use fire if he has it and the rest attack as normal.

subject: Lute
text: Princess Sara gives the party the Lute in the throne room of Corneria after Garland is defeated.

evidence.quote: Congratulations! You have saved the princess from Garland...you are automatically taken back to the the throne room of Corneria where you are given a Lute from the princess.

subject: Bridge
text: After rescuing Princess Sara, the King builds a bridge allowing passage to the next island.

evidence.quote: Now the King will build you the bridge to allow you to pass over to the next island.
